P Schoenfeld Asset Management LP Has Raised Stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) (NXPI) as Stock Rose; Intel (Put) (INTC) Shares Rose While Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Lowered Stake by $1.90 Million
May 26, 2018 - By Vivian Park
P Schoenfeld Asset Management Lp increased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) (NXPI) by 35.03% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. P Schoenfeld Asset Management Lp bought 119,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.13% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 459,100 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $53.76 million, up from 340,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. P Schoenfeld Asset Management Lp who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $40.18 billion market cap company. The stock increased 4.74% or $5.28 during the last trading session, reaching $116.79. About 9.02M shares traded or 40.34% up from the average. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 17.73% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.18% the S&P500.
Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Intel Corp (Put) (INTC) by 99.53% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Llc sold 42,289 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 200 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9,000, down from 42,489 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Intel Corp (Put) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $258.35B market cap company. The stock increased 1.26% or $0.69 during the last trading session, reaching $55.44. About 16.42 million shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
